study.title: Data-Efficient Design of High-Entropy Oxygen Carriers for Chemical Looping Using Active Learning
study.citation: Brorsson J et al. ACS Materials Au 6, 319-326 (2026), with the separately identified METAL companion methods account, arXiv:2601.03933.
study.workflow_type: WAE/GMM composition generation with Gaussian-process uncertainty, Thompson acquisition and CHGNet-based oxygen-carrier thermodynamic evaluation
study.assessment_scope: Author-format reconstruction from the ACS publication, separately attributed companion methods account and verified GitLab cycle-zero database. Initial-cohort quantities are distinguished from acquired proposals. This is complete category coverage, not complete campaign provenance; unavailable records are not replaced with defaults or inferred values.

items.summary: The recovered initial high-entropy oxygen-carrier database contains 1815 cycle-zero configurations, of which 1066 pass the recorded charge-neutrality and Bartel-tolerance screen and 749 are filtered. Its tab-separated export contains the same 1066 retained compositions and target values. The separate dry-reforming illustration starts from approximately 240 entries in a 2401-composition dataset; these populations are not added together. Dataset licence and cross-partition leakage evidence remain unavailable.

items.summary: The proposal model uses perovskite sublattice composition fractions and a target property. The companion methods account specifies an eight-dimensional WAE latent representation, an 80/64/48 encoder, a 48/64/80 composition decoder, and a 192/256/320 property decoder. A GMM is fitted to the latent encoding; Gaussian processes provide uncertainty for Thompson acquisition. These published architectural values are distinct from unverified run-specific hyperparameters.
source_locations: ACS Materials Au Fig. 1c and Method
METAL Sections II.B.1-II.C.1

representation.value: Two seven-dimensional vectors of fractional A- and B-sublattice occupations in ABO3, together with the selected scalar target property.
source_locations: METAL Section II.B.1

value.other_components: Layer normalisation and ReLU; sublattice-wise softmax in the composition decoder; fitted latent GMM

source_locations: METAL Section II.B.1-II.B.3

loss_definition.value: L1 reconstruction with a maximum-mean-discrepancy penalty against an isotropic Gaussian prior. The actual regularisation coefficient is not recovered.
source_locations: METAL Section II.B.2

gp_surrogate.value: The companion account describes GPyTorch Gaussian processes using composition vectors directly, a scaled Matern kernel with individual length scales, and Adam optimisation of negative marginal log likelihood. Learned kernel parameters and their run mapping are not supplied by this description.
source_locations: METAL Section II.C.1, Surrogate models

run_specific_hyperparameters.rationale: The actual regularisation coefficient, GMM component count, GP kernel settings and checkpoint identifiers still need the run archive; code defaults are not evidence of their use.

random_seeds.rationale: Exact seeds and a mapping from seeds to runs are not recovered. Discussion of multiple seeded runs does not supply the seed values.

items.summary: WAE and surrogate updates are part of the acquisition loop; CHGNet supplies an external pretrained interatomic potential. items.summary: A WAE/GMM generates composition proposals and acquisition prioritises candidates for evaluation. The recovered cycle-zero archive verifies the 1815/1066 chemistry screen, separately from acquisition. Later cumulative attempts, unique proposals, repairs, rejections and inference throughput remain unavailable. Entropy-filter statements in the publications are kept separate from the directly verified initial-cohort rule.

sampler_and_conditioning.value: Latent-space WAE/GMM composition sampling combined with Gaussian-process prediction and Thompson acquisition for the selected oxygen-carrier property.

scope_of_filters.value: All 1815 archive flags exactly match rejection on failed charge neutrality or Bartel tolerance > 4.18. Of the 1066 retained entries, 815 have Sconf/R < 1.5, so this initial screen is not an entropy >= 1.5R screen. The ACS Results narrative mentions low-entropy filtering, whereas its Methods and the recovered initial database support the charge/tolerance rule. The companion's acquisition-stage entropy condition is separately attributed, not inferred for every historical run.
source_locations: ACS Materials Au pp. 323-324
METAL Section II.A.2

items.summary: The study targets calculated oxygen-transfer behaviour or process suitability based on thermodynamic evaluation. Its outcome is computational screening, not a newly synthesised material. Novelty, uniqueness, stochastic uncertainty and evaluator-call denominators require explicit records before a general discovery-efficiency claim can be quantified.

items.summary: The companion account compares acquisition and uncertainty strategies, including random, exploratory, greedy and Thompson choices and GP versus MC-dropout uncertainty. This tests search control under the stated application, rather than establishing superiority over all generator families. The matched cumulative evaluator budget and a generator-component ablation still need verification.
source_locations: ACS Materials Au results and Fig. 2
METAL Sections II.C and III

comparison_methods.value: Random, exploration, greedy and Thompson acquisition choices; Gaussian-process and MC-dropout uncertainty variants are discussed in the companion account.
source_locations: METAL Sections II.C and III, acquisition comparisons

budget_matching.rationale: The event-level evaluator counts and identical-budget accounting needed to quantify efficiency differences have not been recovered.

generator_ablation.rationale: A verified ablation isolating the generative component has not been identified; acquisition comparisons are not substituted for it.

items.summary: The record distinguishes charge and tolerance filtering from CHGNet relaxation and thermodynamic targets. The companion account specifies BFGS relaxation until forces are below 0.001 eV/angstrom, and phonon calculations for vibrational thermodynamics. Those calculations are not silently reinterpreted as a reported dynamical-stability pass criterion. New prospective synthesis and independent DFT confirmation of all acquired candidates were not the evaluator used.
source_locations: ACS Materials Au main text, evaluator choice
METAL Sections II.A.2-II.A.3 and II.D

relaxation.value: CHGNet interatomic-potential evaluation with ASE BFGS relaxation to a force threshold below 0.001 eV/angstrom in the companion account.
source_locations: METAL Section II.A.3

vibrational_thermodynamics.value: The ACS Methods specify harmonic PhonoPy calculations with 0.02 angstrom displacements, supercells at least 12.5 angstrom along each axis, and reciprocal-grid density 1000000 atom^-1. These estimate vibrational thermodynamic contributions, not a separately verified dynamical-stability acceptance count.
source_locations: ACS Materials Au p. 324, Property Estimates
METAL Section II.A.3

structure_and_thermodynamic_scope.value: The high-entropy calculation uses 80-atom perovskite supercells, delta steps of 0.0625 up to 0.5, and cubic, orthorhombic and brownmillerite configurations (19 distinct SQSs per composition in the published protocol). OTC is evaluated between reducing conditions of 1050 C and pO2=10^-14 atm and oxidising conditions of 950 C and pO2=0.2 atm. These 19 structures are not multiplied by retained compositions to infer actual evaluator calls.
source_locations: ACS Materials Au pp. 323-324, Structure Generation and Filtering; Property Estimates

explicit_dynamical_stability_acceptance.rationale: A candidate-level imaginary-mode acceptance criterion and corresponding retained count have not been verified. Performing phonon calculations for thermodynamics does not by itself supply that reporting field.

new_prospective_synthesis.rationale: The study chose CHGNet for iterative screening instead of new prospective experiments; its generated-candidate results therefore support a computational screening claim.
source_locations: ACS Materials Au main text, paragraph explaining CHGNet evaluator choice

independent_dft_for_all_new_candidates.rationale: The campaign's stated evaluator was CHGNet, not independent new DFT for every acquired candidate. Comparisons with source DFT data or another MLIP remain separate evidence.

route_and_kinetics.rationale: An experimentally validated synthesis route and candidate-specific kinetics were not established by the available computational screening record; thermodynamic operating conditions are supplied separately above.

items.summary: Gaussian-process uncertainty and Thompson acquisition guide an iterative loop, after which evaluated target values update the database. The ACS paper describes five independent 10-cycle runs followed by a merged 40-cycle continuation; the companion account describes ten initial runs. These different source statements are not silently reconciled. The original run mapping is needed before cumulative evaluator use can be recovered.
source_locations: ACS Materials Au Fig. 1c and Method
METAL Section III.C, Figs. 10-12

acquisition_and_update.value: Gaussian-process uncertainty with Thompson acquisition; evaluated compositions and targets feed the subsequent model/database update.
source_locations: ACS Materials Au Fig. 1c and Method
METAL Fig. 1

published_cycle_scope.value: For the high-entropy campaign, the ACS paper states five independent runs of 10 cycles with identical initial training sets and different random seeds, followed by merging the candidates and 40 additional cycles. Exact seeds are not supplied. This differs from the companion's ten-run description and must be matched to original run records before use as an accounting denominator.
source_locations: ACS Materials Au p. 323, results accompanying Fig. 3

companion_cycle_scope.value: The companion oxygen-uncoupling account describes cycles 1-50, with the first 10 cycles compiled from 10 individual runs after removing duplicate entries. This statement is attributed to that account, not used to infer evaluator totals.
source_locations: METAL Section III.C and Figs. 10-12

separate_energy_uncertainty.value: The ACS dry-reforming suitability calculation treats vacancy-formation energies as normally distributed with standard deviation 0.4 eV. This fixed physical-target uncertainty is distinct from the GP predictive uncertainty used for acquisition.

batch_stopping_and_total_calls.rationale: Exact attempted/accepted batches, stopping decisions, duplicates, retries and cumulative evaluator calls require the run logs.
